summary: Close the gap between what runs on your laptop and what runs in production.
signature: 12 rule codes, file and line on every finding
highlights: Variables your code reads that no env template documents - the boot failure that only happens after deploy
Development and production pointed at the same remote database, named and compared without printing the credentials
Type errors and lint waved through at build time, and source maps published to production
Missing security headers, wildcard CORS, no rate limiter and no health endpoint - each reported once, not once per file
requires: python3 (already on macOS and Linux). Reads your project files only. No network, and it never reads a value out of your environment.
notes: It cannot see your hosting dashboard, which is where the real configuration lives - a project can pass every check here and still be missing every variable in production. It also cannot tell you whether your database has backups.
